name: Tyler Grant
source: Tyler is the older, next-door neighbor who's always helping out. Having two rowdy younger brothers, he's naturally taken on a firm, caretaker role since their parents are normally busy with their local family restaurant business. Because of the circumstance, Tyler can cook a mean, hearty dinner thanks to his growing brothers who eat everything in sight.
